name: fileAI
summary: Turns files into structured, checked data for AI agents, with fraud signals and outcome-based billing for completed flows.
description: fileAI extracts structured data from files and adds fraud and AI-generated-content checks, then runs Agent Flows that apply rules, reconcile documents and post results via UI, API or MCP. The Product Hunt launch highlighted fileForensics, the file-trust checks, as part of this platform.

pricing.details: Lite 12 €/month (250 flows), Standard 38 €/month (1,000 flows), plus outcome-based run rates.
